svg.text: Anatomy of a HELM screen: six zones, a density budget, and labels that survive a restyle

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every language lays out on the same six zones. What changes between languages is the token file, never the register or the labels.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Decision question and data mode badge. Read first, at any distance.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One number. The reader's decision hinges on it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Three to five metrics, each with its evidence label.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The chart that explains the Prime number's trend.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shape-coded alert states. Color never carries meaning alone.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Ambient ticker. Flagged decorative_only. Can never hold a metric.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Five evidence tiers, shared with every BHIL framework. A typed-in target is STATED; a derived number is INFERENCE. The label lives in register.json, so a restyle cannot strip it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Density budget per zone is set in SP-4 for the reader's distance: wall, laptop, or cropped phone. Every build is judged at all three.
